name: How long does it take to design a custom swimming pool?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to design a custom swimming pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom swimming pool design can vary significantly based on complexity, client feedback cycles, and desired features. A straightforward design might take 4-6 weeks, while more intricate projects involving extensive landscaping, unique water features, or integration with existing structures could extend to 8-12 weeks or more. This timeframe ensures thorough planning and client satisfaction before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom pool design duration ranges from 4-6 weeks for simpler projects to 8-12 weeks or more for complex designs.
